title: PCA with an eigendecomposition
summary: Fit PCA by centering, building the covariance matrix and sorting its eigenvectors, then project and reconstruct the data.

mutants.no_centering: Builds the covariance matrix from the raw data without subtracting the mean.
mutants.ascending_order: Keeps the eigenvectors with the smallest eigenvalues first.
mutants.ratio_of_selected: Divides each eigenvalue by the sum of the k kept eigenvalues and not by the sum of all.
mutants.no_sign_fix: Does not flip the sign of the eigenvectors, so the sign depends on the library.
mutants.inverse_forgets_mean: Reconstructs the data without adding the mean back.
